text:
Rita Chen: flag — OrbitCommerce onboarding: token burn +30% MoM, short-chat p95 ~1.25s. Traffic main to rw-infer-13b-hosted; renewal flagged as risk in 90d if costs don't improve. Proposed conservative ops: 1) canary short replies (<=70 tokens) to rw-infer-8b-q2 2) route /v1/checkout and /v1/confirm to their dedicated eu-north pool 3) enable prefix/KV caching for repeated cart prompts and prime cache. Thoughts?

Omar Singh: good plan. bench shows ~28% cost save and ~+65ms p95 on 8b-q2 vs 13b. keep canary small (4%) and gate with eval harness. also recommend prompt template trim for boilerplate.

Liam O'Connor: infra: need warm-up to avoid cold p99. suggest prime top-250 prefixes and jitter ramp to 20% to avoid cache stampedes. add alerts: semantic_drop>2% or p99_delta>250ms.

Priya Desai: renewal owner here — customer wants measurable savings before signing. I'll run enablement + approval session after 48h. please capture objective metrics and subjective survey.

Rita Chen: ops-bot — please create canary 4% (match=max_tokens<=70), fallback=rw-infer-13b-hosted, warm-up top-250 prefixes over 12m. set quality hook semantic-similarity and auto-rollback threshold -2%.

ops-bot: Deploy acknowledged. Canary route=orbit/8b-q2-canary, traffic=4%, match=max_tokens<=70, fallback=rw-infer-13b-hosted. Warm-up job scheduled: prime top-250 prefixes over 12m. Alerts: p99_delta>250ms, semantic_delta<-2%, kv_hit_rate<65%. Link: https://console.redwood/inbox/canaries/2412345678

Omar Singh: eval harness snippet: ```json
{"canary":"orbit-8b-q2","prompts":["cart_check","apply_coupon","shipping_eta"],"threshold_pct":97}
```

Liam O'Connor: monitoring: gpu_util, kv_hit_rate, serve_latency_p50/p95/p99. if kv_hit_rate < 70% after warm-up, pause ramp and extend prime.

Priya Desai: scheduling enablement Fri 09:30 CET, collecting 4-5 representative prompts. will add acceptance checklist: 48h review, rollback plan, and cost target >=20%.

Rita Chen: timeline: 48h at 4% with eval hook; if semantic_delta within -2% and p95_delta <200ms, ramp to 25% over 24h and enable auto-prefix caching top-400. keep Gainsight updated.

ops-bot: Canary reached 48h. Results: traffic=4%, semantic_delta=-0.6% (ok), cost_estimate_reduction=31%, p95_delta=+78ms, p99_delta=+110ms, kv_hit_rate=80%. No auto-rollback.

Omar Singh: recommended: roll to 25% and enable prefix caching for top-400 prompts. prepare dashboard card and rollback playbook.

Liam O'Connor: will validate steady-state kv_hit_rate >75% at 25% traffic. will post metrics after scale.

Priya Desai: customer signoff pending 72h review window; collecting subjective feedback in a short survey post-enablement.

Rita Chen: thanks team — if all good after ramp we'll include savings in renewal offer. closing thread after final 72h report. :rocket:
